Day trip

River Walk

An easy morning loop along the water — café stop included.

Book a guide

The trail follows the north bank for 6 km. Bring water; the kiosk at the bridge opens at 9 am.

Trailhead: 47.1 N, 8.5 E — follow the blue markers.
Dogs are welcome on a lead.

Distance
6 km
Climb
120 m
Grade
easy
Spring
Summer
Autumn
style
rule

On the trail

Morning

Start at the old mill and keep the water on your left.

Afternoon

Shade is scarce after noon; the bridge café closes at 5 pm.
